text: Our paper Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning is on arXiv. It will be presented as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 NEmo workshop on 11 December.

Two team reports from Apart Research's AI Collusion Research Sprint: peer swaps and tacit collusion in pricing agents.
Designed and hosted the roundtable What makes cooperation without control work? for the Post-Control Initiative.

Finished at the PRISM AI Safety Research Fellowship, where I contributed technical research to our world-models project and volunteered in program support, after presenting the world-models project at the fellowship's final poster showcase.
Joined the Sentient Futures Project Incubator.
Published Detection Is Not Containment, my first-author report from Apart Research's AI Incident Response Sprint.

Started at the PRISM AI Safety Research Fellowship, as a technical research contributor on a world-models project mentored by Jobst Heitzig and as a Program Support Volunteer. Also began AI evaluation and benchmarking research at BaseThesis Labs.
Gave the talk "Agentic AI: The Shift from Tools to Autonomous Actors" for Lean In Network's HIGH series.

Started as a research intern at IISc's DREAM Lab.
